mapper.select: SELECT sido, sigg, IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(roadStr, ' ', -1) like '(%)', TRIM(replace(roadStr, SUBSTRING_INDEX(roadStr, ' ', -1), '')) , roadStr) AS roadStr FROM( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(FIRM_ADDR, ' ', 1) AS sido, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(FIRM_ADDR, ' ', 2), ' ', -1) AS sigg, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(FIRM_ADDR, CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(FIRM_ADDR, ' ', 2))+1), ',', 1)) AS roadStr FROM CBCI_USER WHERE USER_CODE = #{value}) AS result_tb
